items.title: Henry A. "Hank" Kmen Interview, 1963-02-13
items.q: One time I remember a guy called Mad Tale.

ctx.x: Did you have any ideal saxophone player that you felt influenced your style earlier? Who did people look up to in those times?

It was the earliest I can remember when people looked up to Coleman Hawkins. That early, huh? Yes, sir. When he was playing with Fletcher Henderson. And I mean real early, I'd say, when he was playing with Fletcher Henderson. So many of the American musicians started to date Coleman from the time he came back from abroad and made that body and soul that he was playing Greyhorns way before then. This is Rio 3, Henry Comin, February the 13th, 1963. We're talking about Saxe Mansfield. He was one you liked.
